skill: peg_insert
dsl_version: 2

  offset:

  - 0.0
  - 0.055

  anchor: fixture
  weight: 0.7
phases:

  termination: time_limit
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: fixture
    entity: peg_socket
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.055
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: channel_axis
      tolerance: 0.05

skill: peg_insert
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_above_entry
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.05
  weight: 0.2
- id: reach_insertion
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - -0.03
  weight: 0.8
phases:
- id: approach_above_entry
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.055
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: channel_axis
      tolerance: 0.1
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.04
      - 0.08
      default: 0.055
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: reach_above_entry
- id: align_at_entry
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.055
    tolerance: 0.003
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: channel_axis
      tolerance: 0.05
  parameters:
    lateral_offset_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.015
      - 0.015
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.x
        mode: add
    lateral_offset_y:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.015
      - 0.015
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: add
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: reach_above_entry
- id: descend_insert
  type: insert
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.055
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.05
      axis: channel_axis
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: channel_axis
      tolerance: 0.05
  parameters:
    insertion_depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.03
      - 0.07
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    insertion_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_guard
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: abort
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.005
    - 0.005
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: reach_insertion
- id: push_home
  type: push
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - -0.01
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.01
      axis: channel_axis
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: channel_axis
      tolerance: 0.05
  parameters:
    final_push_depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.005
      - 0.02
      default: 0.01
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: reach_insertion

skill: peg_insert
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_above_entry

  - 0.0
  - 0.1
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_insertion
  anchor: fixture
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_above_entry
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: socket_entry

    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    tolerance: 0.005

      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0

      tolerance: 0.01
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.15
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:

    approach_speed:

      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.15

        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_above_entry
- id: align_at_entry
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: socket_entry
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    align_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    lateral_offset_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.03
      - 0.03
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:

        mode: add
    lateral_offset_y:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.03
      - 0.03
      default: 0.0

      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: add
  subtask_id: reach_above_entry
- id: descend_insert
  type: insert
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: socket_entry
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - -0.02
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    force_threshold:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 5.0
      - 30.0
      default: 20.0

      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    insertion_depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.05
      - -0.01
      default: -0.03
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    insertion_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: max_force_guard
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: reduce_speed

- id: push_home
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: socket_entry
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - -0.05
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    final_push_depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.06
      - -0.02
      default: -0.04
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.05
      default: 0.02
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: max_force_guard_push
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 40.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 1
    strategy: reduce_speed
  subtask_id: reach_insertion
